observable_outcome: The Increment lifecycle in docs/architecture/domain-model.md describes exactly the twelve statuses and thirty-three transitions that DecideIncrement implements, the closure test comment no longer claims a documentation gap, the M1 evidence states the measured test count, and make check and make candidate are green.
acceptance_criteria: A1. docs/architecture/domain-model.md section 5 no longer shows a ready-to-proposed transition or any Increment transition into a paused status, and states in one or two sentences that pausing work on an Increment is expressed by a Control Intent scoped to the Increment together with the Requirement paused state, and that re-proposal creates a new Increment rather than returning an existing one to Proposed. The Requirement lifecycle section keeps its own paused state unchanged.

A2. The Increment status list and transition table in that section match the implementation exactly: the twelve IncrementStatus values and the thirty-three accepted (from-status, command, to-status) edges asserted by the closure test in internal/domain/invariant_model_test.go.

A3. The comment in internal/domain/invariant_model_test.go that describes the documentation gap is updated to state that the diagram and the declared edge table now agree; the declared edge table itself and every assertion are unchanged.

A4. .agents/v2/evidence/V2-010-domain.json has its test-count prose corrected from 27 to the measured 26 (16 baseline plus 10 new). Every measured count, both evidence keys, created_at and the check list stay otherwise byte-identical in meaning; no observation is removed.

A5. .agents/v2/evidence/index.json is updated so the evidence_hash of the V2-010 artifact equals the sha256 of its new bytes, and a new entry is appended for .agents/v2/evidence/V2-043-docs-alignment.json (id ev-v2-043-docs-alignment, task_id V2-043, component docs, result passed) whose evidence_hash equals the sha256 of that artifact.

A6. devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/domain passes with the same 26 top-level tests, and devbox run --pure -- go test -count=1 ./internal/contracts passes including TestActiveEvidenceIndex.

A7. devbox run --pure -- make check is green, executed after committing so the secret scan reads committed history, and devbox run --pure -- make candidate returns candidate true after regenerating build/evidence.
A8. No file outside allowed_paths changes.
constraints: Work only inside the assigned isolated task worktree; never push.
Never use git reset, git checkout --, git stash or git commit --amend.
Do not widen the implementation to match the diagram; the ruling is that the diagram follows the implementation.
Read the evidence key only after make check is green on the final tree, because a formatting-only change moves a component key.
